title: Raise Lok Sabha seats by 50%, freeze delimitation till 2051: What new bill proposes
content: The Union Cabinet has given the green light to a new bill aimed at expanding the Lok Sabha from 550 to 850 seats. This legislation introduces a significant milestone—a one-third reservation for women in both the Lok Sabha and state assemblies, set to commence in 2029. Additionally, it proposes a uniform 50% increase in constituencies across all states, based on the 2011 Census.

title: Bisleri in fresh trouble, after Goa FSSAI finds bacteria in West Bengal water sample
content: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has initiated prosecution against Bisleri International over unsafe drinking water samples. Recent tests revealed coliform bacteria in samples from its West Bengal and Goa plants. FSSAI has restricted the sale of specific batches following these findings and intensified surveillance on packaged drinking water quality. The regulator aims to ensure compliance with food safety norms across the country.

title: US pushed Venezuela, Iraq to quit OPEC to boost oil output: Report
content: The United States influenced both Venezuela and Iraq regarding their membership in OPEC earlier this year. After the removal of Nicolás Maduro, discussions were opened about Venezuela potentially leaving the organization. Prime Minister Ali Faleh al-Zaidi also contemplated Iraq's OPEC exit amid US investment talks. Ultimately, Iraq's oil ministry convinced him to stay and seek a higher production quota.

title: Musk sends 'Well Done' message to MIchael Dell as company reports record revenue
content: Dell founder Michael Dell announced record financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2027. Revenue reached $54.9 billion, representing a 103% increase year over year. The company also reported significant gains in AI server revenue, which surged to $22 billion. Additionally, Dell experienced a robust AI backlog valued at $132.3 billion. The firm raised its revenue guidance for fiscal year 2027 to $202 billion.

title: How DMK's year-long negotiations with BJP paved way for delimitation deal
content: After intense negotiations, DMK decides to support the BJP-led Union government's delimitation bill, a notable change from their previous stance. This strategic move comes after discussions concerning proportional seat adjustments and census freezes. DMK aims to balance its political aspirations while safeguarding Tamil Nadu's representation in the Lok Sabha, underscoring that party interests remain a top priority amid earlier fears of losing seats.

title: Punjab University women's rafting team wins 2 golds, silver in grade 4 rapids

title: Texas rock shelter yields 6,500-year-old kit with boomerang, darts and hide
content: In a remarkable archaeological find in West Texas, researchers uncovered a hunting kit that dates back approximately 6,000 years. The collection features various stone and wooden foreshafts, along with essential hunting tools, including a partial atlatl, which is an ancient spear-throwing apparatus. The diversity of materials suggests varying time periods, unlocking valuable insights into the lifestyles and surroundings of these ancient communities.

title: Texas grants SpaceX permit as data center approvals start before Hinojosa’s term

Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa has promised to pause new data center developments and end tax breaks for the industry. Local authorities are set to discuss a property tax break for the project on December 9.
